elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination ... Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Transition assistance charged at then-current rates
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination (not gated on request)
elements.evidence: (b) within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems
and certify such deletion in writing
transition assistance for up to six (6) months
within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format

reasons: All five preferred atomic elements are express in new 10.3: 6-month transition window, then-current rates, 30-day return running from expiry or termination, standard machine-readable format, and deletion followed by written certification.

The 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance in limb (a); the data-return and deletion/certification obligations in (b) and (c) are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow mandatory data return.

The insertion is a single new paragraph filling a genuine gap (the original 10.1-10.2 and 16.5 give no data-return or migration right), leaves 10.1, 10.2 and 16.5 untouched and effective, and introduces no undefined terms or contradictions; 'Customer Data' is a defined term.
Fallback thresholds are also satisfied on their own terms, though the drafter's locked preferred level is what governs and is complete.
Minor drafting note only: 'reasonable' qualifies the assistance, which is customary and does not defeat the preferred position.
